description: Delete the existing super_monster/ directory completely and create the new v2 foundation: __init__.py, __main__.py, config.py with domain classification rules, methodology config, and color constants.
steps: Create __init__.py with VERSION='2.0.0', brief docstring about Super Monster v2 being an elite adaptive bug bounty scanner with inline verification
Create __main__.py with standard entry point pattern (import main, call main())

Create config.py (~400 lines) containing: DOMAIN_TYPES dict mapping domain categories (payment, auth, api, admin, cdn, web) to keyword lists and prefix patterns. SCAN_TESTS_PER_TYPE dict mapping each domain type to which tests to run. SEVERITY_RULES for what severity different verified findings get on different domain types. TIMEOUTS (10s per request), RATE_LIMITS (1s between requests to same host), MAX_THREADS (5), colorama Colors class with fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Old super_monster/ directory is completely removed
New super_monster/__main__.py exists and is importable
New super_monster/config.py exists with DOMAIN_TYPES, SCAN_TESTS_PER_TYPE, SEVERITY_RULES, TIMEOUTS, Colors class
Running 'python -c "from super_monster import VERSION; print(VERSION)"' outputs 2.0.0
verification: python -c "from super_monster.config import DOMAIN_TYPES, SCAN_TESTS_PER_TYPE, Colors; print('OK')"
findings: Python not globally set initially; used pyenv global 3.11.15 to activate. colorama was already installed. All verification commands pass. Branch is feat/apk-analyzer (inherited from previous work).
